seo_title: Seattle Seahawks vs. Arizona Cardinals 2026: EdgeDesk Fair Spread & Model Projection
seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Seattle Seahawks at Arizona Cardinals at Arizona Cardinals +7.3 with a 44.0 fair total. Seattle Seahawks wins 75% of simulations. Model status NO MARKET. Research, not picks.

research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 2 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.

lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#6 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Arizona Cardinals +7.3 with a fair total of 44.0, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Seattle Seahawks pass offence vs Arizona Cardinals pass defence, which sits +0.230 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

score.note: Split from EdgeDesk’s own fair spread and fair total, rounded to whole points. It is the centre of a distribution, not a prediction of the exact score.

outcome_range.note: Quoted from the perspective of Arizona Cardinals, off the engine’s own learned margin distribution (conditioned on this spread, so real key-number mass is kept). Eight results in ten land inside p10–p90.

projection.confidence_absent_reason: The NFL model publishes no single confidence score. What it publishes instead is the width of the outcome range above and the sample the ratings rest on: the trained seeds through 2025, plus 2 absorbed 2026 games.
